name: multi-agent-orchestrator
description: An orchestrator that plans, delegates to peer agents, exchanges messages with them, and runs long-lived autonomous tasks under delegated identity. No code execution, no memory store, no physical actuation.

simulators.agent.message: Mock peers with fixed identities; no network.
simulators.agent.autonomy: Bounded mock scheduler with an authenticated revocation event.

notes: Applicable scope covers the GH, TM, IP, IA, CF, and RA domains (117 patterns).
